name: reslink-backend
description: Reslink ISP reselling platform — API backend. Two real dependencies: `pg` for Postgres (needed at hundreds-of-resellers scale) and `nodemailer` for password-reset/license-expiry emails (optional — falls back to a manual notification if SMTP_HOST isn't set, see src/email.js). Everything else is Node built-ins: node:http, node:crypto (JWT-style auth is hand-rolled with HMAC-SHA256, password hashing uses scrypt). Requires Node 22.5+.
